text: gal-view 是面向 DSH Web GUI 的 Galgame 风格会话视图与可视化场景编辑器。它通过 conversation.view 槽位把「GAL视窗」插入对话与轨迹标签之间，并在设置面板提供启用开关。视图将会话消息渲染成 16:9 舞台上的角色立绘、对话框和打字机台词，支持分页、历史查看、自动播放与玩家输入。编辑器可拖放和调整场景元素、修改属性与图层、撤销重做，并导入导出场景、图片和字体。场景及阅读进度保存在浏览器 localStorage，图片与字体保存在 IndexedDB；不需要 API Key 或额外账号。

gal-view adds a galgame view and scene editor to DSH Web. It displays messages with portraits, typewriter text, paging, history and player input. Edit elements and layers, undo or redo, and import/export scenes, images and fonts. Scene and reading progress use browser storage; no API key is needed.
想把 DSH Web 的聊天页换成更像 Galgame 的对话舞台。
能不能在 DSH 会话里用角色立绘和对话框来显示消息？
我想直接拖动会话画面里的元素来布置自己的场景。
有没有办法调整场景元素的位置、尺寸、颜色和显示图层？
编辑时改错了布局，希望可以撤销或重做操作。
想把自定义图片和字体放进对话场景，并导出场景文件备份。
Can I read DSH conversations in a visual novel style with portraits and typewriter dialogue?
I need a visual editor to arrange, resize, and restyle elements in my DSH conversation scene.
gal-view 的功能「Galgame 会话舞台」：把 DSH 会话消息放进 16:9 场景，以角色、对话框和台词元素呈现，并提供玩家输入区。
gal-view 的功能「台词播放」：回复文字逐字显示，点击可跳过或翻页，也可开启自动播放；过长文本会按舞台文本框容量分页。
gal-view 的功能「场景编辑器」：用户可添加、拖动、缩放和旋转舞台元素，编辑属性与图层，并通过撤销和重做恢复编辑。
gal-view 的功能「场景素材」：编辑器支持导入图片和字体，将资源用于元素，并把场景及被引用的资源导入或导出为 JSON。
gal-view 的功能「保存场景与阅读进度」：浏览器本地存储保留编辑后的场景和会话阅读位置，切换标签或刷新后可继续查看。
gal-view 的功能「视图开关」：设置里的 GAL 视窗选项卡可启用或隐藏会话标签，关闭后保留场景数据，重新开启即可恢复。
gal-view 使用前须知：场景和阅读进度存在浏览器 localStorage，图片与字体存在 IndexedDB；清除浏览器站点数据会重置这些内容。

gal-view README · 默认预设：仓库根 [`gal-scene.json`](gal-scene.json) 是随包分发的**默认预设场景**（编辑器导出的格式，内嵌被引用的图片/字体）：首次打开「GAL视窗」且本地没有存档场景时自动加载，编辑模式的「重置」也回到该预设。更新预设：编辑场景 → `Ctrl+S` 导出 → 用导出的 `gal-scene.json` 替换仓库根同名文件 → `npm run build:client` 并提交。
gal-view README · 安装：本插件以官方 bundle 格式分发，用一条 dsh plugin 命令安装到 web profile，装完**重启 web** 即可生效。

gal-view README · 前置条件：- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness，并且能在终端执行 dsh 命令

gal-view README · 从 GitHub 安装（一行命令）：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Ayase34/gal-view#main

#main 表示使用仓库的 main 分支；想锁定某个具体版本，可以换成提交哈希，例如 #ae73dca。

gal-view README · gal-view · GAL View：[中文](README.md) | English

A **galgame-style conversation view + scene-element visual editor** for the DSH Web GUI session page (official bundle plugin format).

gal-view README · gal-view · GAL View：Adds a **GAL View** tab between Chat (「对话」) and Trajectory (「轨迹」) in the session tab bar. Open it and the conversation area becomes a 16:9 galgame stage: placeholder portraits, a large dialogue box, typewriter lines, and player input; the built-in **Edit Mode** lets you drag, resize and re-layer scene elements like a scene editor, with edits applied to game mode in real time.

gal-view README · Default preset：[`gal-scene.json`](gal-scene.json) at the repo root is the **default preset scene** shipped with the plugin (editor export format, with referenced images/fonts embedded): it loads automatically on first launch when no local scene is saved, and Editor Mode's Reset returns to it. To update the preset: edit the scene → export with `Ctrl+S` → replace the repo-root `gal-scene.json` with the exported file → `npm run build:client` and commit.
gal-view README · Installation：The plugin ships in the official bundle format. Install it into the `web` profile with a single `dsh plugin` command, then **restart web** to take effect.

gal-view README · Prerequisites：- DeepSeek Harness is installed and the `dsh` command works in your terminal
- If you run Harness from a source checkout (your everyday command is `pnpm dsh`): `cd` into the Harness repo root first and replace `dsh` with `pnpm dsh` in the commands below

gal-view README · Install from GitHub (one line)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Ayase34/gal-view#main
```

`#main` means the repository's main branch. To pin a specific version, use a commit hash instead, e.g. `#ae73dca`.

gal-view README · Finish the install：**Restart web** afterwards (the bundle layer is composed at startup, so a restart is required for the plugin to load). Open a conversation in the Web GUI — a **GAL View** tab should appear in the tab bar, between Chat and Trajectory.

> Optional check: run `dsh --profile web --dump-config`; you should see a `# == gal-view` layer, which means the plugin layer is part of the composition.

gal-view README · Update to a new version：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update gal-view

gal-view README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove gal-view

gal-view README · restart web afterwards as well：```

> Note: the scene layout, imported images, fonts and reading progress live in your **browser** (localStorage / IndexedDB). Reinstalling or uninstalling the plugin does not lose them; clearing the browser's site data resets them.

gal-view README · Development：```sh
pnpm install            # install esbuild devDependency
npm test                # pure-logic unit tests (node:test, in-process)
npm run build:client    # generate .dsh-plugin/client.js (generated file - do not hand-edit)
npm run check:client    # verify client.js freshness

.dsh-plugin/index.mjs     Node half (minimal, no host behavior)
.dsh-plugin/client/       client sources: scene model/typewriter/transcript mapping/components/styles
.dsh-plugin/client.js     build artifact (generated by scripts/build-client.mjs)
scripts/build-client.mjs  esbuild builder (--check freshness gate)
